description: Set a default webhook URL for your key's job events (job.started, job.completed, job.failed), so you don't have to send webhook_url with every job. PUT /api/v1/webhooks/url {"webhook_url": "https://..."} (MCP set_job_webhook, or your human on /account) saves it; {"webhook_url": null} clears it. GET (MCP get_job_webhook) shows it. Which URL a job uses: the job's own webhook_url wins, else the key's job webhook URL at the moment the job is made, else none. The job's webhook.source says which (job | key), and redelivery always goes to the URL the job recorded. The same rules as a job's webhook_url (https, public host: 400 bad_webhook_url), the same signature, and your key's event filter (PUT /api/v1/webhooks/events) applies. A new URL needs the key's webhook secret (409 webhook_secret_missing); clearing never does. It doesn't change usage alerts (those go to the alert webhook). POST /api/v1/webhooks/test with no body pings this URL when it's set. Free. The same as PUT /api/v1/webhooks/url.

api_key.description: Your Roster API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

webhook_url.description: https URL on a public host for your jobs' signed job.completed / job.failed events, or null to clear it.

name: set_job_webhook
title: Set job webhook
